name: Name
destinationsFailed: Could not load destinations. Retry before changing this selection.
ruleTask: Choose which traffic to match and how to handle it.
complexRule: This condition needs the advanced editor. All existing settings are preserved.
domainHelp: Enter domain patterns or IP/CIDR ranges. This data belongs to this rule.
processHelp: Enter application process paths. Process detection must be available on the managed device.
customOptions: Advanced DNS settings are active. They are preserved while editing this rule.
topLevelAny: The rule matches when any of these conditions matches.
allTrafficHelp: Matches all traffic. Rules below this rule may be unreachable.
selectorsHelp: Change one selected node to update every rule using this destination.
noSelectors: Create a shared destination when several rules should change nodes together.
deleteSelectorConfirm: Delete this shared destination? Referenced destinations cannot be deleted.
nodeImportHelp: Paste node links, a base64 node list, or exported node JSON. Preview before importing. Imported nodes receive new IDs.
subscriptionImportHelp: Add a subscription and fetch its nodes now. You can refresh it later from Subscriptions.
chooseImportFile: Choose a JSON or text file
importFileTooLarge: The file must be 4 MiB or smaller.
subscriptionNameRequired: Enter a name for this subscription.
subscriptionNameConflict: A different subscription already uses this name. Choose another name.
defaultAfterImport: Default destination after import (TCP and UDP)
importInvalidItems: These entries could not be imported. Correct them or import only the valid nodes.
templateReplaceConfirm: Replace the current connection settings with this template?
nodeChainHelp: Connection steps run in the displayed order. Use the advanced editor to add or reorder steps.
setFallbackHelp: TCP retries the last successful node first, then tries other candidates in this order.
nodePickerFailed: Could not load nodes. Retry to change this selection.
useAsDefault: Use this node as the default for TCP and UDP
sharedListHelp: This rule references an existing list. Editing that list affects every rule using it.
defaultDestinationHelp: Used by proxy traffic when a rule does not choose a specific node or shared destination. Changes take effect immediately.
combinedDestination: One node for TCP and UDP
setupHelp: Choose a default destination, enable a traffic entry, then test a website. You can add routing rules afterwards.
setupChooseDestination: Select or import a node to handle proxy traffic.
setupEntryEnabled: A traffic entry is enabled. Check its listener status before connecting.
setupChooseEntry: Choose how applications or devices send traffic to yuhaiin.
setupTestHelp: Check DNS, routing and the selected destination for a website.
activationDegradedHelp: Some remote list data could not be loaded. Healthy conditions still match; rules that depend only on missing data will not run.
activationPartialRule: Partially active rule (healthy conditions still apply)
entryTaskHelp: Choose how applications or devices connect to this server.
entryUnsupported: This protocol is not supported by the managed server platform. Choose a supported protocol before enabling it.
tunAdvancedHelp: Address ranges, routes, MTU and driver options are preserved. Open the advanced editor to adjust them.
tunInstructions: TUN requires device permissions or an Android VPN device descriptor. Enable it and check the listener status. The preset captures IPv4 traffic; configure IPv6 and excluded routes in the advanced editor as needed.
localEntryInstructions: Configure applications on the managed device to use this proxy address. This entry accepts local connections.
lanEntryInstructions: Configure other devices to use the managed device’s reachable IP and this port. Replace your-device-ip with that IP.
entryAuthInstructions: Configure the username and password entered above in your client.
entryVerifyListener: Save the configuration and verify that the listener is running before connecting.
entryPresetReplace: Replace the current listener and protocol settings with this preset?
entryCapabilitiesFailed: Could not load server capabilities. Basic proxy setup is available; platform-specific options need a successful refresh.
previousConfigurationRunning: The previous configuration is still running.
activationWaiting: Saved changes are waiting to be applied
automaticDNS: Automatic (use the default DNS for this traffic)
dnsRolesFailed: Could not load DNS query settings.
directDNSHelp: Used after a direct-routing rule matches, unless that rule chooses another resolver.
proxyDNSRole: DNS for proxy traffic and classification
proxyDNSHelp: Used to classify addresses and resolve proxy traffic locally when needed. A rule can override the resolver after matching.
bootstrapDNSHelp: Resolves the hostname of DNS servers themselves. The default uses the managed device’s system resolver.
dnsPageHelp: Query settings choose upstream DNS services. Listening settings let applications or other devices send DNS queries to yuhaiin.
dnsListenHelp: Optional DNS listening address for clients. Leave empty to stop this DNS listener; upstream query settings remain separate.
routeThisHost: Create a rule for this host
routeThisProcess: Create a rule for this application
connectionDraftHelp: The new rule opens as a draft. Review its conditions and destination before saving.
resourceUnavailable: This resource is no longer available.
shareMatchingHelp: Saving makes this a shared list. Other rules can reference it, and future edits affect every rule using it.
defaultRoutingHelp: Choose what happens when no routing rule matches.
listenerStatusHelp: Listener initialization and incoming request counts do not confirm successful forwarding. Run diagnostics to check connectivity.
routingOverviewHelp: Match traffic, choose an action, and send it to the right destination.
ruleOrderHelp: {{count}} rules · evaluated from top to bottom
selectRuleHelp: Choose a rule to edit its matching conditions and destination, or create a new rule.
discardRuleChanges: Discard unsaved changes to this rule?
selectNodeHelp: Choose a node to inspect its connection settings, run connectivity checks, or set the default destination.
defaultNodeFailed: Could not change the default destination.
defaultNodeStateFailed: Could not load the current default destination.
noMatchingNodes: No matching nodes. Try another keyword.
dragRuleHelp: Drag this handle to reorder. On touch screens, hold it before dragging; swipe normally to scroll. Arrow keys move a focused handle; Escape cancels dragging.
selectSelectorHelp: Choose a destination to update its node for every rule that uses it.
selectResourceHelp: Choose an item from the directory to view its settings, or add a new one.
countryPickerHelp: Choose one or more countries from the current GeoIP database.
countryPickerEmpty: No country data is available. You can enter codes manually.
countryPickerFailed: Country data could not be loaded. You can still enter codes manually.
resolverTestHelp: Test these settings without saving them. Each test makes a fresh query.
dnsTypesFailed: Could not load DNS record types.
dnsNoRecords: The server returned no records. Check the response code; an empty answer does not imply a connection failure.
saveSubscriptionBeforeUpdate: Save your changes before fetching nodes from this link.
subscriptionUpdateHelp: Fetch nodes using the saved subscription settings.
hostTargetHelp: Map a host or IP to an IP address or host alias. Port-specific mappings are also supported.
fakeIPListHelp: Mappings in the current IPv4 and IPv6 pools. Deleting a mapping removes its reverse lookup; DNS requests may create a new mapping.
searchFakeIP: Search domain or full IP address
gatewayRouteHelp: TCP only. Matching connections enter this Gateway when its inbound interception settings permit them. Other traffic continues through normal routing; UDP and DNS skip this action.
outboundNoObservations: No observations yet. This does not mean the node is offline.
outboundStateHelp: Passive connections and manual tests are observations, not a guarantee of continuous connectivity. They expire after two minutes.
outboundStatusError: Failed to load outbound runtime status.
outboundTrafficHelp: Payload traffic at this node boundary. Nested proxy chains can account bytes on multiple nodes.
dnsResponsesHelp: Return your own DNS records or response codes before FakeIP, hosts and upstream DNS.
dnsResponsesMatching: The first matching rule wins. An exact name matches only itself; *.example.com matches subdomains at any depth, excluding example.com. Use * for all names or query types.
dnsResponsesEmpty: No custom replies. Queries continue through the DNS pipeline.
dnsResponseAnswers: Record data, one answer per line
dnsResponseAnswersHelp: Enter only record data, such as ::1, 10 mail.example.com., or "custom text". Empty NOERROR replies contain no records (NODATA).
dnsResponseCodeHelp: This response code is returned for the selected query type. NXDOMAIN means the name does not exist; use an empty NOERROR reply to suppress only this record type.

auto.lockHint: Lock uses the selected node above. Turn it off to resume automatic selection.
auto.measurementHint: Download measurements approximate this target at this time; live business Bps is separate. Repeat tests to reach the sample threshold. Periodic tests require explicit schedule enablement. Failed or cancelled tests consume the reserved daily budget.

monitor.allowMobile: Allow while mobile host reports foreground
monitor.allowMetered: Allow speed tests on metered networks
monitor.probeHint: Probes use the candidate node. Enterprise VPN authentication is never started by periodic work; it can reuse a manually established client. Mobile probes require an explicit foreground signal from the native host.
monitor.speedHint: Periodic tests use the same byte, time and shared daily limits as manual tests. Metered networks and mobile background work are disabled by default.

costPolicies.allow_expensive: Allow metered probes; reuse established VPNs

circuit.title: Circuit breaker and recovery
circuit.hint: Failure and recovery thresholds above also control the breaker. Open blocks new connections; half-open admits a limited recovery trial. Established connections keep their outbound node.
